title: Practice 4: Verbs that take the dative

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ну, да я не завидую ___ (твоё превосходительство), поверь мне.
exercises.why: After the verb помогать the person to whom help or assistance is given is in the dative case: *Я помогаю ему. Она помогает брату. After the verb обещать the person to whom something is promised is in the dative case: *Капитан обещал старшине отпуск. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 35, 36. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «After the verb помогать the person to whom help or assistance is given is in the dative case.» — DLI, Lesson 35.
exercises.context: After the verb помогать the person to whom help or assistance is given is in the dative case: *Я помогаю ему. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 35, 36. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
